display.purpose: The big transfer time on Stats.

subtitle.purpose: Artist under the title, in ink-soft.

mono.purpose: Live pipeline line and debug values only.

motion.name: cover-crossfade
motion.purpose: Default cover change when the board announced no transition; cut under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: cover-transition-replay
motion.purpose: Approximate replay of the transition the keychain just drew.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Connect Spotify / Sign in again; the only filled button in the app.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2E7D32; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; padding: 12px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 27px; outline: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.25); outline-offset: -4px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1565C0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Dots
components.description: Filled dot = connected, hollow ring = not connected; colour is never the only cue.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-size: 13px; color: #5A5A5A; } .ds-status .ds-dot:not(:first-child) { margin-left: 7px; } .ds-dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-on-green { background: #2E7D32; } .ds-off { border: 2px solid #767676; } .ds-dim { color: #6B6B6B; }

components.name: Live Strip
components.description: Under the cover: fills in fresh orange while sending, solid blue with a filled marker when cached.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 280px; } .ds-strip-mark { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #E65100; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-strip-track { flex: 1; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #E4E4E0; overflow: hidden; } .ds-strip-fill { display: block; height: 100%; width: 62%; background: #E65100; border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.3s; } .ds-strip:hover .ds-strip-fill { width: 100%; }

components.name: Art Stage
components.description: The cover, the only floating object: soft ink shadow plus a yellow hand-drawn frame offset behind it (Crayon).
components.css: .ds-art-wrap { position: relative; width: 200px; height: 200px; } .ds-art-frame { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translate(6px, 7px) rotate(0.6deg); border: 3px solid #FFD400; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-art { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF8A00, #FF2D20 45%, #9B2FD6); box-shadow: 0 10px 13px rgba(26,26,26,0.14); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Custom 52x30 track; green fill when on, grey outline when off.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; color: #1A1A1A; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-track { width: 52px; height: 30px; border-radius: 15px; border: 2px solid #767676; box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #767676; transition: left 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-track { background: #2E7D32; border-color: #2E7D32; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-track .ds-knob { left: 25px; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + .ds-track { outline: 3px solid #1565C0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stats Tabs
components.description: Text tabs with a state marker; selected is ink with a filled blue dot.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; width: 320px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: none; font-family: 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-size: 13px; color: #6B6B6B; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab .ds-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #767676; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-tab.ds-sel { color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-tab.ds-sel .ds-dot { background: #1565C0; border-color: #1565C0; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1565C0; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
This is the app for a digital keychain. The Spotify cover is the hero, the one big thing on the screen, drawn as the keychain shows it and replaced whole, never half-loaded. Your own photos (and GIFs, planned) are secondary actions. Everything else is small: two status dots, a thin live strip under the art, the track name, three playback marks and a one-line footer. A person opening the app for three seconds should see the cover, see that both dots are filled, and put the phone away.

There are three themes, picked in Settings. They share one layout, one set of text roles and one token vocabulary. **Crayon** (default) is a white page with hand-drawn, slightly wobbly marks in Chalkboard SE; colour lives only in the marks, never in the words. **Quiet** is near-black with system type, crisp geometry, and colour only in the two status dots and the cached strip. **Keyring** is warm paper with the keychain itself drawn around the cover, so the screen shows what is on your keys right now; it uses SF Pro, tag-style SF Mono labels, and one signal orange. A theme changes values, never structure: adding one means adding a `ThemeID` case and its tokens, not new screens.

Each theme has its own control style. **Crayon: drawn, not built.** Wobbly outlines with slight tilts, so buttons look like someone drew them. **Quiet: few and quiet.** There are no filled buttons, just small icons with tiny labels, and the picture does the talking. **Keyring: the keychain is the picture.** Controls are plain ink marks on paper with 12pt corners; the drawn device carries the character. Icons are a small in-house set drawn on a 20×20 grid in the theme's hand, not SF Symbols chrome. Every control has a target of at least 44pt.
keyCharacteristics: One hero: the square cover, centred, at the largest width the screen allows (inside the drawn keychain on Keyring).
Status through filled dots vs hollow rings, never through colour alone.
Three themes, one structure; all values come from `@Environment(\.theme)`.
Hand-drawn wobble and the keychain housing are tokens (`wobble`, `housing`), not separate component sets.
Text scales with Dynamic Type and honours Bold Text in every theme.

rules.name: The Colour-Means-Something Rule
rules.body: Only state marks (dots, strip, toggles, phase bars) and the primary button are coloured. Words are ink, soft or faint. A colour that only decorates is listed in `artPalette`/`doodle`/`rule`/`housing` and carries no meaning.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text token clears 4.5:1 against its theme's background, and every state-carrying mark clears 3:1. Where a mockup colour failed, the token was darkened and the mockup value noted in a `Theme.swift` comment. Keep doing that.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule (Keyring)
rules.body: Keyring has exactly one non-ink colour besides Spotify green: #C2410C, meaning "the keychain" (the Display dot, a cached cover, the slider). A cover sent fresh is plain ink with a hollow marker. Nothing else is tinted.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Views ask for a `TextRole` via `.themeText(_:)` and never set a font, size, weight or case directly. A new kind of text gets a new role mapped in all three themes.

rules.name: The Crayon Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Crayon copy is lowercase and playful ("empty it", "keychain ready"); Quiet and Keyring use sentence case. Case comes from `ThemeCopy.swift`, not from text transforms, except Keyring's tag labels, which uppercase via the role.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule (Keyring)
rules.body: SF Mono is for status, counts and timings only. Song titles, artists, rows and sentences stay in SF Pro.

rules.name: The Cover-Width Rule
rules.body: The live strip, track info and footer all align to the art slot's width. Nothing on Now Playing is wider than the slot except the header.

rules.name: The Only-the-Cover-Floats Rule
rules.body: No cards, no shadowed buttons, no layered panels. If something besides the cover (or Keyring's keychain) needs separation, use a `ThemedDivider` or spacing.

dos: Do read every colour and metric from `@Environment(\.theme)`, and add a token to all three themes when a screen needs a new one.
Do pair every coloured state with a filled-vs-hollow `StateMarker` or a dash pattern, so it reads without colour.
Do keep text tokens at 4.5:1 or better and state marks at 3:1 or better, noting any mockup value you darken in a comment.
Do give every control a hit area of at least 44×44pt while keeping its visible mark small.
Do route all wording through `ThemeCopy.swift`: lowercase for Crayon, sentence case for Quiet and Keyring.
donts: Don't branch on the theme name for colour or layout; a theme changes token values, not view structure.
Don't set fonts directly; use `.themeText(_:)` roles.
Don't draw a cover partially, or show progress on top of the art. Progress lives in the live strip.
Don't show a cached or drawn state before the keychain confirms it.
Don't add cards, shadows or tinted panels: only the cover (or Keyring's keychain) floats.
Don't use colour on words in Crayon; colour belongs to the marks.
Don't add a second accent to Keyring beyond the one signal orange.
